scope: One proposed small-token WGMMA geometry only; not a universal claim against WGMMA.

independent_arithmetic.original_expression: 768 units * 8 warps * 128 FP32 values * 4 bytes * 2 read/write
independent_arithmetic.proposed_expression: 192 units * 2 warpgroups * 512 FP32 values * 4 bytes * 2 read/write
independent_arithmetic.shared_expression: 36608 retained metadata + 3 * 36864 weight slots + 8 * 4096 * 2 activation cache

why_no_go: One CTA and eight useful compute warps remain; packed weight traffic and TMA copy count do not decrease.
Reduced cross-K partial traffic is more than offset by added logical shared activation requests before cache fill stores.
For one or two jobs, 64 or 128 complete phase-B units underfill 132 SMs; larger units can worsen critical tails even when total requested weight bytes match.
Removing the activation register cache may reduce registers, but baseline standalone small paths have no reported local storage and shared memory still prevents two CTAs.
No retained small-path hardware attribution establishes a sufficiently large removable issue/helper/dependency cost.

whole_decoder_scenarios.qualification: Profile-share scenarios, not latency bounds or predictions; PDL overlap and separate captures limit attribution.

limits: Payload counts are not measured shared transactions, HBM traffic or latency.
Saved M16 route histograms are standalone evidence and cannot determine decoder distributions.
The 144/148/149 register captures are standalone; decoder M1 uses different MULDEC/FINPF flags.
The proposed mapping, descriptor, cache lifetime and compiler resource allocation have not been implemented or GPU-validated.
